from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from shop.notices import send_notice


@pytest.fixture
def days():
    return 5


# flowguard: event NOTICE_CASE(days: int; tmp_path) calibrated_by=tests/test_notices.py::test_notice
def test_notice(days: int, tmp_path):
    outbox = tmp_path / "outbox.txt"
    sent = send_notice(days, str(outbox))
    assert type(sent) is bool
    assert outbox.exists() is sent
